{{- /* Waline — full upstream-equivalent loader */ -}} {{- $w := .Site.Params.waline | default dict -}} {{- if not ($w.serverURL | default "") }}{{/* credentials required */}}{{ else }} {{- $c := .Site.Params.comments | default dict -}} {{- $lazyload := $c.lazyload | default false -}} {{- $count := $c.count | default false -}} {{- $option := $w.option | default dict -}} {{- $pageview := $w.pageview | default false -}} {{- $metaCSS := $w.meta_css | default false -}} {{- $imageUploader := $w.imageUploader | default true -}} {{- $use := $c.use | default slice -}} {{- if reflect.IsSlice $use | not }}{{ if $use }}{{ $use = slice $use }}{{ else }}{{ $use = slice }}{{ end }}{{ end -}} {{- $norm := slice -}} {{- range $use }}{{ $norm = $norm | append (. | title) }}{{ end -}} {{- $first := "" }}{{ if gt (len $norm) 0 }}{{ $first = index $norm 0 }}{{ end -}} {{- $js := $w.js | default "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@waline/client@3.8.0/dist/waline.js" -}} {{- $css := $w.css | default "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@waline/client@3.8.0/dist/waline.css" -}} {{- $metaCssUrl := $w.meta_css_url | default "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@waline/client@3.8.0/dist/waline-meta.css" -}} {{- end }}
